column1: # Real plant measurements. THIS FILE SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE.
# Nothing in this project will invent values for it. Fill in one row per
# photograph
# Columns
#   trial             any label
#   species           what the plant actually is. If you do not know
#                     "unidentified herbaceous" -- do NOT write "sunflower"
#                     unless it is one.
#   stem_height_m     soil surface to stem tip
#   base_diameter_mm  calliper/ruler diameter at the soil
#   tip_diameter_mm   diameter near the tip
#   condition         rest
#                     the zero-deflection reference)
#   wind_speed_ms     measured airspeed if you have an anemometer. LEAVE BLANK
#                     if you do not -- the script then runs trend mode and
#                     labels the result as calibrated rather than validated.
#   tip_angle_deg     angle of the base->tip line from vertical
#                     Use src/scripts/photo_angle.py to get this from a photo.
#   notes             fan distance
trial
